stories.headline: D23 live updates: Exclusive trailers shown for new movies, shows - ABC7 Los Angeles
stories.summary: From newly announced movies to rides coming to a Disney park near you soon, we have all the live updates from D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event.
stories.why: Disney is signaling a massive slate of theatrical releases and theme park expansions—if you're a father planning vacations or a nostalgic millennial, your entertainment and wallet are both about to be heavily targeted for the next 2+ years.

stories.headline: Da'Vine Joy Randolph Sues Landlord Over Alleged $17K a Month Rental From Hell - TMZ
stories.summary: Da’Vine Joy Randolph is dragging her landlord to court … claiming she rented a luxury home for $17K a month … only to have to deal with pests and plumbing issues ... TMZ has learned.
stories.why: A rising Black actress (Oscar winner for 'The Holdovers') suing over uninhabitable luxury housing exposes how even high-earning entertainers get exploited—it's a real-world counter-narrative to the 'made it' fantasy.

stories.headline: Ryan Gosling Shows Off First Footage From ‘Star Wars: Starfighter,’ About “A Guy From the Wrong Side of the Galaxy” - hollywoodreporter.com
stories.summary: The Shawn Levy-directed project is set to fly into theaters May 28, 2027.
stories.why: Ryan Gosling directing a Star Wars film with an outsider protagonist signals the franchise is betting big on prestige casting and grittier storytelling to win back adult male audiences who've grown cynical about Disney's approach.

stories.headline: New 'Avengers: Doomsday' trailer drops at D23 featuring Robert Downey Jr. and more - ABC News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos
stories.why: RDJ returning as Doctor Doom in a multi-hero Avengers event is the MCU's nuclear option to reverse declining viewership—this is Marvel admitting they need legacy star power and nostalgia to justify another $400M+ investment.

stories.headline: ‘X-Men’ Finally Unveils Its Cast, Including Adam Driver, Inde Navarrette, Christopher Abbott - The Hollywood Reporter
stories.summary: Broadway star Maya Boyd will play Storm in the feature, which has a May 2028 release date.
stories.why: Adam Driver and Christopher Abbott headlining X-Men signals Marvel's pivot toward A-list dramatic actors over superhero-franchise veterans, suggesting they're treating mutants as prestige material rather than IP to milk.

stories.headline: D23 2026: Star Wars: Ahsoka Season 2 Teaser Trailer and Release Date Revealed - StarWars.com
stories.summary: Creator Dave Filoni and stars Rosario Dawson, Hayden Christensen, and Eman Esfandi tease the next chapter for Ahsoka Tano.
stories.why: Hayden Christensen returning alongside Dave Filoni shows Star Wars is doubling down on nostalgia-driven storytelling and canon-building for the 35-45 demographic who grew up with the prequels.

stories.headline: Marvel Unveils Trippy First ‘VisionQuest’ Trailer - The Hollywood Reporter
stories.summary: Paul Bettany and James Spader star in the Disney+ series for Marvel Studios.
stories.why: A Paul Bettany-led Marvel+ series suggests the MCU is testing whether A-list talent can anchor streaming projects without ensemble casts—this determines if Disney+ becomes must-watch or secondary content.

stories.headline: ‘Tangled’ Sets March 2028 Release Date as First Footage Debuts at D23 - variety.com
stories.summary: Disney has set a release date for its live-action adaptation of "Tangled" and unveiled the first footage from the movie.
stories.why: Disney greenlit a live-action Tangled with major footage at D23, signaling aggressive remakes of pre-2010 properties to capture both Gen-X parents and millennial nostalgia simultaneously—this is the template they're betting on.
